story_theme_en: Lin's mango orchard is a rectangle. It is 45 meters wide and 78 meters long. What is the area of the orchard? If Lin wants to put a fence around the orchard, how long does the fence need to be (this is the perimeter)?
helper_tip: Area of rectangle = width x length. Perimeter = 2 x (width + length).
hint_th: พื้นที่สี่เหลี่ยม = กว้าง x ยาว ความยาวรอบรูป = 2 x (กว้าง + ยาว)

worked_examples.question_en: Rectangle: width 10, length 20. Find area and perimeter.
worked_examples.solution_en: Area = 10 x 20 = 200 sq m | Perimeter = 2 x (10+20) = 60 m

common_mistakes: Multiplying all four sides together for area (wrong!)
Forgetting to multiply by 2 when finding perimeter
hints: Area = width x length = two adjacent sides multiplied.
Perimeter = all sides added together = 2 x width + 2 x length.
